description.text:
An advent calendar for Christmas 2008, with a card behind each of its 24 doors. Every card reprints a Diamond & Pearl era card, keeping its set symbol and number, and adds a foil snowflake stamp: gold on 23 of them, and silver on the Christmas Eve card, a holo Pikachu (the DP16 Black Star promo), which came with a Diamond & Pearl booster pack.

The calendar was not sold in the United States. Collectors place it in Canada, where Toys "R" Us carried it, and in several European countries, and know English, French and German copies. The cards sat in their slots on sharp cardboard prongs, so many copies carry dents from the packaging.
